title: [MAIN] Fix customer GST application posting sequence (Bug 659070)
summary: Fixed a posting sequence error when applying GST advance payments against sales invoices with different customer posting groups by deferring GST journal posting until after customer application posting completes.
key_points: Resolves the 'G/L Entry already exists' error when applying a GST advance payment to a sales invoice with a different customer posting group
Cause: GST application entries were posted early through a separate Gen. Jnl.-Post Line instance while customer application posting was still running
Offline customer GST journal posting is now deferred until customer application posting finishes
Uses the shared Gen. Jnl.-Post Line instance supplied by OnAfterPostApplyCustLedgEntry
Affects both application posting and its preview
quote: Defer offline customer GST journal posting until customer application posting finishes.
